name: @nimblebraininc/todosforagents
description: To-do boards for AI agents, kept in one SQLite file on your own machine. No account, no cloud service.

database_path.title: Database file
database_path.description: Where your boards are stored. Leave empty for the default: todos.db in your user data directory. Keep it on a local disk, not a network share.

tools.name: create_todo
tools.description: Create a to-do. Defaults to the workspace's default board (auto-creating it); status defaults to open.

tools.name: plan_todos
tools.description: Lay down a multi-step plan in one additive call - the decomposition primitive. Safe on a board a human also edits; idempotent on retry. Rows carry a details preview.

tools.name: update_todo
tools.description: Explicit partial, null-safe update of a to-do's fields. Does not touch status (transition verbs own that).

tools.name: start_todo
tools.description: Move a to-do to in_progress and clear its blocked_reason.

tools.name: complete_todo
tools.description: Move a to-do to done and set completed_at.

tools.name: block_todo
tools.description: Move a to-do to blocked and record the blocked_reason.

tools.name: reopen_todo
tools.description: Move a to-do back to open, clearing completed_at and blocked_reason.

tools.name: cancel_todo
tools.description: Move a to-do to cancelled (won't do) and set completed_at.

tools.name: reorder_todos
tools.description: Batch position update within a status lane (the board UI sends the full order on drop).

tools.name: archive_todo
tools.description: Archive a to-do - set archived_at to hide it from default views (status unchanged).

tools.name: list_todos
tools.description: List to-dos with optional filters (board, status, assignee, label, parent), a text query over title and details, and cursor pagination. Rows carry a details preview; get_todo reads the full details.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Get a to-do with its full details, its steps (each with a details preview), counts, and recent activity timeline.

tools.name: get_next_todo
tools.description: The agent's 'what do I do next' - the highest-priority actionable to-do (open, not blocked).

tools.name: get_board_summary
tools.description: Read-only board health: per-lane counts, totals, and what needs attention (overdue, stalled, blocked).

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a board; columns defaults to the four canonical lanes (Open / Doing / Blocked / Done).

tools.name: update_board
tools.description: Partial board update. Editing columns re-maps the human view without touching any to-do's canonical status.

prompts.name: get_started
prompts.description: Start your to-do list, or pick it up: plan your first to-dos, or see what is in progress and what is next.
prompts.text:
Help me get started with my to-dos. First check my board with get_board_summary.

If there are no to-dos yet, ask me what I am working on, then propose 3 to 5 concrete to-dos. Once I agree, create them with plan_todos, then tell me the keys they got.

If there are to-dos, tell me what is in progress and what is next (get_next_todo), naming each to-do by its key.
